title: Amazon plans to invest $100M to build a robotics manufacturing facility in Indiana, set to open by 2028; its robots at 300+ facilities help with 75% of orders (Isabella Simonetti/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Isabella Simonetti / Wall Street Journal: Amazon plans to invest $100M to build a robotics manufacturing facility in Indiana, set to open by 2028; its robots at 300+ facilities help with 75% of orders — Company, which uses robots for sorting and moving packages inside warehouses, is among world's top manufacturers of them
